How We Started

Born From Frustration, Built on Craft

Our founder Aryan spent months searching for a teak dining table that fit his 3BHK without occupying half the room. Every showroom had the same options — too large, wrong finish, wrong wood, or outrageously priced. So he hired a local carpenter, sketched the table himself, and had it made to exact dimensions.

Friends started asking where he got it. That question became Square Cube — a studio where every customer gets the same experience: tell us what you want, we build it.

Today we have a 12,000 sq ft workshop in Pune with 40 craftsmen, and we ship to every corner of India. The philosophy hasn't changed.

What We Stand For

Our Values

Craftsmanship First

Every joint, every finish, every detail — inspected by our master craftsmen before it leaves the workshop. We have a zero-compromise policy on quality.

Made to Order, Made to Last

We don't stock furniture. Each piece is built specifically for you, in the wood you choose, to the dimensions you need. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

Pan-India Delivery

From Kashmir to Kanyakumari — we pack, ship, and assemble your furniture wherever you are. Our delivery partners handle white-glove service.

2-Year Warranty

All teak and sheesham pieces carry a 2-year structural warranty. We stand behind our work — if anything breaks from normal use, we fix it.
